test_title: PYST 62: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.

Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is: **1st letter + 4 = 2nd letter; 2nd letter - 2 = 3rd letter;**

Option 1) HLJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b922eced30327275cbf0a61e3688892a1795838b237b45dfd95d671e0165fa8b.png] 

**Option 2) GIK**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed381a85376116a6a4c404c66316e9f80a29a5283c4e96eb6ef7cf6f27e9efb6.png] 

Option 3) LPN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbbed56c5adf8f6f419d02fbfd045442be3836b877f9fcbee182c68c9c21119d.png] 

Option 4) BFD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/205e2a23afb9ccd59041c9e6a3286003320eb925abfe885db17df87c5120c7de.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"GIK".**
